text:
Lina: p99 spike on SSE streaming right after today's rollout (merge 6f1a2c3) — p99 went from 60ms -> 220ms for short responses.
Mateo: noticing it too, tracing shows bigger serialization time on the server side.
Alex: CI perf alert hit: https://ci.internal/jobs/streaming-p99 — SRE-bot reported +2.8x
SRE-bot: [alert] perf-regression/streaming-p99 > 2.0x baseline
Priya: preliminary flamegraph: serialization(encode_proto) jumped to ~45ms from ~5ms; also KV-prefill path now adds ~30-40 bytes per entry -> bigger frames.
Tom: batch-autosize PR was the big change today (PR #824). It changed batch size selection and enabled kv-prefill-by-default.
Alex: running git bisect locally, I can repro on master with 6f1a2c3 -> points to commit abcdef1 (merge of autosize + prefill)
Mateo: can we isolate whether kernel autoselect picked different kernels because batch size distribution changed? If so that could hit some kernels with poor vectorization.
Priya: yes, kernel_autoselect picked the "fast-path" for larger seq shapes but actually the model had tiny sequences; mismatch caused fallback to the slower int8-compat kernel. profiling snippet:
```
profile: model_forward
  kernel_exec: 12us (before) -> 80us (after)
  encode_proto: 5ms -> 45ms
  kv_prefill_serialize: 0.8ms -> 28ms
```
Tom: interesting — so two compounding effects: bigger serialized payloads from kv-prefill + a suboptimal kernel chosen due to altered batch-size histogram.
QA-Jordan: I can add a small end-to-end perf test to CI that simulates many short SSE streams to catch this before merge.
DevEx-bot: Canary rollout flagged: hold further rollouts for release/edge until manual approval (reason: perf-regression streaming p99)
Alex: propose immediate revert of abcdef1 while we fix kv serialization and kernel selector heuristics.
Mateo: agreed. quick revert command:
```
git revert -m 1 abcdef1 --no-edit
git push origin revert/abcdef1
```
Priya: I'll sketch a patch: disable kv-prefill-by-default and add guard to kernel_autoselect to consider sequence-length-percentile.
Tom: I'll open an internal RFC for batch-autosize with detailed microbench matrix.
SRE-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-082 streaming-p99-regression, assignees: Alex, Priya, Tom
Lina: thanks everyone — holding rollout and reverting now. let's keep messages here for test results and patch progress.
QA-Jordan: adding link to perf reproducer script: https://git.internal/repro/stream-sse-short.sh
Alex: local revert pushed, can someone verify staging perf? I'll watch the canary dashboard.
Mateo: running staging run now — will post numbers in 5m.
QA-Jordan: staging p99 back to 62ms after revert, looks good :thumbsup:
Lina: great, let's merge the revert, close the incident once rollout stabilizes, and include a test to catch kv-prefill serialization regressions.
Priya: filing follow-up issue: PERF-537 kv-prefill-serialize-optimization + kernel-autoselect-tuning
Tom: assigned to team runtime/perf, ETA 2 days for a prototype.
Lina: done — closing thread when incident resolves. :white_check_mark:
